processors: AMD EPYC 7773X (64 cores / 128 hardware threads per host)
handoff: Parquet over NFS on the separate 10 GbE network

Milan: native kg head, RAM RDB, in-process WAL in journaled runs
Tinkara: native kg HDB, two native kg subscribers, native kg publisher, separate native kg live and historical quote readers

control: Python standard library starts kg processes, checks receipts, samples host counters, and controls the rate search. Every IPC operation is issued by kg.
run_notes: The first launch for each WAL-disabled profile encountered an occupied HDB port before any trades were measured. The bounded profile restarted on the original ports, and the strict profile used fresh ports on the same interfaces. Both used fresh databases.
